title: BFI president and secretary general trade suspensions amid power tussle
description:
The power struggle in the Boxing Federation of India intensified on Wednesday with president Ajay Singh and secretary general Pramod Kumar suspending each other, both alleging violations of the federation's constitution.
Singh suspended Kumar on Tuesday pending an inquiry into alleged financial irregularities, non-cooperation with investigations and misuse of authority.
On Wednesday, Kumar issued a counter-order suspending Singh pending the outcome of a no-confidence motion, which he had planned to move during a Special General Meeting (SGM) on October 28. He had claimed the support of a majority of affiliated state units to move the no-confidence motion.
Kumar accused Singh of continuing to exercise executive control over the federation despite being served a cease-and-desist notice on October 8.
However, Singh rejected his suspension, calling it "unauthorised and without constitutional basis".
